startUrls.title: Sites or sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: Site homepages (the Actor reads robots.txt and falls back to /sitemap.xml and friends) or direct sitemap URLs (.xml, .xml.gz, .txt, sitemap indexes).

changedSince.title: Only URLs changed since
changedSince.description: Keep only URLs whose <lastmod> is at or after this moment. Accepts an ISO date (2026-10-01), an ISO datetime, or a relative period: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m. Child sitemaps whose own lastmod is older are skipped entirely, which makes incremental runs fast. Leave empty to list everything.

keepUrlsWithoutLastmod.title: Keep URLs without lastmod when filtering by date
keepUrlsWithoutLastmod.description: When 'Only URLs changed since' is set, URLs that have no <lastmod> are dropped by default. Enable this to keep them.

includeUrlPattern.title: Include URL pattern (regex)
includeUrlPattern.description: Only list URLs matching this case-insensitive regular expression, e.g. ^https://www\.example\.com/blog/

excludeUrlPattern.title: Exclude URL pattern (regex)
excludeUrlPattern.description: Skip URLs matching this case-insensitive regular expression, e.g. \.(jpg|png|pdf)$

checkStatus.title: Check HTTP status of each URL
checkStatus.description: Send a HEAD request (GET fallback) to every listed URL, 5 at a time, and add status, finalUrl, redirected and contentType. Charged as a separate 'status-checked' event.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Stop after this many unique URLs have been listed. The run cost is bounded by this number.

maxSitemaps.title: Maximum sitemap files
maxSitemaps.description: Stop fetching sitemap files after this many (indexes and leaves combined).

maxDepth.title: Maximum index nesting depth
maxDepth.description: How many levels of sitemap indexes to follow. 0 reads only the sitemaps named in robots.txt or the input.

discoverFromRobots.title: Discover sitemaps from robots.txt
discoverFromRobots.description: For site URLs, read /robots.txt 'Sitemap:' lines first. If disabled or nothing is listed, common paths such as /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml are tried.

skipUnchangedSitemaps.title: Skip child sitemaps older than the date filter
skipUnchangedSitemaps.description: When filtering by date, do not download child sitemaps whose <lastmod> in the index is older than the cutoff.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout for sitemap downloads and status checks.

userAgent.title: User-Agent header
userAgent.description: Sent with every request. The default is a plain desktop browser string.
userAgent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/129.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
